_comment: WHAT THE LEAGUE ACTUALLY REQUIRES OF A MATCHDAY PROGRAMME.
This file exists so nobody has to remember the rules, and so nobody has to
take my word for them either. Every entry carries the source it came from and
the season that source covers, because a rule checked once is a rule that will
be wrong eventually.
THE CORRECTION THAT PRODUCED THIS FILE.
The Combined Counties League removed the requirement to PRODUCE a programme at
its June 2026 AGM. It is tempting to read that as 'nothing is required any
more'. That reading is wrong, and Rule 8.14 says why: the rule was never about
compelling production. It opens 'Where physical programmes are produced...' and
states 'An acceptable match programme shall include any official sponsor
provided advertisements which shall be forwarded to members by the Board.'
Those conditions attach to producing one, so they survive the AGM change
untouched. Rayners Lane is choosing to produce a programme, so they apply.
STATUS VOCABULARY, used honestly:
league-when-produced - proven by current League rule, conditional on producing
league-baseline      - stated in the published Administration Guide, whose
current edition predates this season; treated as the
baseline until a 26/27 guide supersedes it
club-policy          - Rayners Lane chooses to include it
recommended          - FA / football good practice
optional             - pure editorial choice
Nothing is labelled a regulation without a rule reference behind it.

sources.title: Combined Counties Football League — Administration Guide
sources.note: The current published guide. It predates this season, so it is the baseline, not the last word. Its 'all clubs must produce a match programme' line is superseded by the June 2026 AGM; its description of what an acceptable programme contains is not.

sources.title: League Rule 8.14 — match programmes
sources.edition: as printed in the Administration Guide
sources.note: Conditional by construction: 'Where physical programmes are produced...'. Applies to Step 5 and 6 matches played under the auspices of the Competition.

sources.title: CCL AGM June 2026 — programme production no longer mandatory
sources.note: Press report, not the rule book. Treated as evidence that the PRODUCTION requirement was removed, and as nothing else. Confirm against the 26/27 handbook when the League publishes it.

sources.title: CCL — Information → Downloads (official sponsor artwork)
sources.note: The only place league advert artwork may be taken from. Never a search engine, never redrawn.

requirements.requirement: Details of the players — name and playing number — of BOTH sides
requirements.quote: This must, as a minimum, include details of the players (name & playing number) of both sides
requirements.note: Squad and player details available at production time. NOT the official team sheet, which is exchanged later, and never the manager's private selection.

requirements.requirement: The colours in which the teams will play
requirements.quote: the colours in which the teams will play
requirements.satisfiedBy: Today's Teams page — kit strip for both clubs
requirements.note: Was entirely absent from the programme until this audit. Rayners Lane colours are stored once in data/config.json; the opposition's are confirmed per edition.

requirements.quote: and details of the match officials
requirements.note: Entered once by the Secretary on the fixture, reused here. Never invented: if appointments have not arrived the page says so.

requirements.requirement: Official sponsor-provided advertisements forwarded to members by the Board
requirements.quote: An acceptable match programme shall include any official sponsor provided advertisements which shall be forwarded to members by the Board.
requirements.satisfiedBy: League advert pages, from the official artwork library
requirements.note: The one requirement stated inside the rule itself rather than the guide. Artwork comes from the League's Downloads page as supplied — never recreated, never cropped.

requirements.requirement: Complimentary copies: 3 visiting dressing room, 3 match officials' dressing room, max 6 visiting club officials, plus visiting League Officials — before kick-off
requirements.quote: at least three complimentary programmes shall be provided in the visiting team dressing room, three in the match official's dressing room and a maximum of six programmes for visiting club officials
requirements.satisfiedBy: Print checklist — a human task, not a system one
requirements.note: Applies only where PHYSICAL programmes are produced. The software cannot verify it and does not pretend to; it prints the checklist.

requirements.requirement: Where an electronic programme is produced, notify it in the match confirmation; link available to visitors and spectators up to 24 hours before; live for the whole season
requirements.quote: Where electronic programmes are produced, this should be notified in the match confirmation.
requirements.satisfiedBy: Permanent edition URL, copy-link action, and season-long archive

requirements.requirement: The club secretary is responsible for seeing that the programme is produced; the editor role may be delegated
requirements.quote: The club secretary is responsible for seeing that the programme is produced. The role of programme editor is one that may be delegated to another person.
requirements.satisfiedBy: Secretary sees compliance status and can correct official match details; the Programme Editor builds and publishes the edition

requirements.requirement: Comments in the programme are attributed to the club; inappropriate criticism of the FA, County FA, the League, its officers, appointed match officials or another club can lead to a County FA charge
requirements.quote: Be aware that any comments that appear in the club programme are attributed to the club. If any inappropriate criticism is made of the FA, County FA, the League, its officers, appointed match officials or any other club, you could find yourself on a charge with the County FA.
requirements.note: The basis for flagging sensitive copy for human review. Flags for a person to read — it never censors on keywords alone.
No programme rule requires this. FA affiliation places safeguarding duties on the club; printing them is the club's own choice, and a good one.

requirements.requirement: Ground regulations and conditions of entry

requirements.satisfiedBy: Acerbis page from the Programme Library
requirements.note: Club editorial. Not a League requirement and must never be presented as one.

leagueAdverts.title: PST Sport Advert 2026
leagueAdverts.note: Filed by the League as 26-27, uploaded July 2026 — the artwork for this season. No commercial title is claimed here because the League's own material does not state one.

leagueAdverts.title: Cherry Red Records Advert 2025
leagueAdverts.note: Competition title sponsor. Latest artwork the League publishes, dated 2025 — confirm at the season check whether a 26/27 file replaces it.

leagueAdverts.title: MJM Sports Programme Advert 2024
leagueAdverts.note: A LEAGUE advertiser, not a Rayners Lane partner. MJM was previously listed in the club's own sponsor file as 'Club Partner' on no evidence beyond a logo file existing; that designation has been withdrawn pending the club confirming whether a direct relationship exists.

3 copies in the match officials' dressing room
Up to 6 copies for visiting club officials
Copies for any visiting League Officials
Copies for any FA or County FA officials attending
All of the above handed over before kick-off
